name: Stormbird HX-40

mission.role: Fictional tandem-seat twin-engine jet for the existing island game
mission.performanceStatus: Arcade targets only; physical sizing incomplete

frames.cad: millimetres: X right, Y forward, Z up; source dimensions in metres
frames.game: metres: X right, Y up, Z aft

wing.convention: Main wing only; constant root chord across centerline strip; root fairings excluded.
wing.section: Custom 9 percent thickness section with 0.4 percent sinusoidal camber; no validated polar.

massProperties.status: Required: component mass budget, loading cases, CG and inertia. Body offset is a scene datum only.

aerodynamics.status: Custom sections have no measured or computed polars; simulator lift and thrust values are tuning constants.

propulsion.layout: Two intake ducts, 24-blade compressor rotors, continuous 6 mm core casings and aft exhaust liners
propulsion.status: Engine internals, pressure recovery, thrust map and fuel consumption unanalysed.

compressorGeometry.sections: Three-section cambered foil loft, stagger 50/37/29 degrees, circumferential sweep -7/0/9 degrees
compressorGeometry.status: Concept geometry; no validated compressor aerodynamics or manufacturing tolerances

mechanisms.groundContactStatus: Geometry-derived neutral hull and rigid tire profiles; sampled terrain approximation.

cockpit.pilotEyeStatus: Provisional camera datum; anthropometric occupant and reach analysis required.

assists: Automatic gear command below 35 m or gear-speed threshold
Direct pitch and roll response; self-leveling; coordinated-turn and sideslip assistance
Arcade lift, drag and engine acceleration; no rigid-body inertia integration

evidence.savedCAD: 527 valid positive-volume solids in current intake master; rotor and casing fit checked against fuselage and wing roots
evidence.seatFit: 84 mounted seat parts; front/rear headrest glazing gaps 193.7/108.3 mm, limited to seats
evidence.newMeasurements: 4 exported tire pivots matched; static pitch and bank ground clearance at 0/80/160 mm oleo compression
evidence.compressorFit: 1,152 sampled annular passage points; zero blocked by checked airframe; rotor/airframe overlap zero; representative blade roots and both spinners embed in hubs
evidence.priorMechanismChecks: Gear check retained from engine-cavity revision before final wing-root mouth and wall trims; older door/seat evidence retains original document hashes
